photo.caption: Samples used for election audits
photo.description: Number of cases and reliability in samples used for election audits. Some samples are specified as at least 1% (or 3%, 5%) of precincts or voting machines, rounded up to the next whole number of precincts or machines. The sample would typically be hand-counted to find errors made in earlier counts.
